zoe_marketing: Quick pulse for tomorrow's KPI review  need final MQLs, launch-post CTR, and influenced pipeline from the webinar + launch posts. Can we lock numbers by 5pm PT?

ada_analytics: Will do. Raw pull shows MQLs = 356 (webinar 198, launch posts 101, paid social 57). Avg CTR launch posts 2.6%. Influenced pipeline est $508k (pre-recon).

mike_growth: Any inbound routing problems? Sales reported a handful of late handoffs yesterday.

sam_ops: Saw SFDC ingestion backpressure 14:10-14:38 PT, ~16% of events delayed. Eng applied exponential backoff and replayed queue. Ticket #eng-sre-4512.

rachel_sales: AEs experienced 7 leads arriving >24h late; booking cadence affected. Please include routing SLA bullet.

ada_analytics: Also ran an attribution sensitivity: switching from a 7-day last-touch to a 28-day window increases webinar-attributed pipeline by ~58% for the March cohort. I'll attach a tiny table. SQL used for cohort export:

```
SELECT date(registered_at) AS cohort, source, count(*) AS regs
FROM leads
WHERE registered_at >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1 DESC;
```

zoe_marketing: For the Friday slides we need: top 3 wins and top 3 risks. I propose wins = strong webinar attendance, launch-post CTR lift, paid social efficiency. Risks = attribution variance, routing delays, limited messaging lift on variant B.

mike_growth: I'll own metrics + sensitivity table. Ada will produce visuals. Zoe narrative. Sam ops will add reconciliation note. Rachel add seller impact bullet.

sam_ops: Reconcile done at 14:55 PT. Post-replay mismatch <1.1%. Hotfix ticket closed.

rachel_sales: Noted. I'll add a seller quote about delayed follow-up impact for the appendix.

ci_bot: automated note: slides uploaded to drive at https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch_kpi_1755551234. Hotfix #eng-sre-4512 marked resolved.

zoe_marketing: Final exec takeaway draft: "Webinar delivered the largest visible pipeline lift; attribution window materially affects crediting; routing delays introduced minor GTM friction." Approve?

ad a_analytics: Approve. See you at the 9am review.
